faq: What are the five steps of a Mixpanel setup?
Event tracking spec, implementation with verified data flow, analytics strategy, dashboards, then deeper analysis. The order matters — each step depends on the one before it.
Why can't you start with dashboards?
Because a dashboard built on unverified events shows you numbers that look right and aren't. The spec and the verification are what make everything above them trustworthy.
Verification. Inserting the code is treated as the finish line, when the actual finish line is firing every event from every surface and confirming it lands with the right properties.
